visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with brown hair in a ponytail, wearing a white button-down shirt and blue jeans, stands in a bright, modern kitchen studio. She smiles warmly at the camera while holding two halves of a fruit cream sandwich. The background features a large window with wooden blinds, a white kitchen counter, and various kitchenware on wooden shelves. She then lowers the sandwiches and presents a large, vibrant bunch of green grapes to the viewer with an enthusiastic facial expression. (2) The scene shifts to a detailed tutorial sequence. The woman pours white sugar from a glass bowl into a large stainless steel bowl containing liquid cream. She uses a white electric hand mixer to whip the cream until it reaches a thick, stable consistency. She then adds a dollop of white mascarpone cheese and continues mixing. A close-up shot follows her hands using a white knife to slice green grapes on a wooden cutting board, arranging the slices into a flower-like pattern. She spreads the cream on white bread, places green and purple grapes inside, wraps the sandwich in clear plastic wrap, and marks a cutting line with a black marker. (3) After showing the sandwich being placed in and removed from a white refrigerator drawer, she cuts it diagonally through the plastic. She pulls the halves apart to reveal a cross-section where the grapes form a floral pattern in the cream. The woman takes a large bite of the sandwich, looks into the camera with a satisfied smile, and gives a thumbs-up gesture. The final sequence shows her sitting at a wooden desk with a laptop, enjoying a bowl of the same green grapes while working in a softly lit indoor environment.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a cheerful female Mandarin greeting at a moderate volume and high pitch. A bright, upbeat acoustic guitar and piano BGM starts immediately, creating a positive atmosphere. (2) As the narrator transitions to the tutorial steps, the BGM continues consistently. A distinct, low-frequency mechanical whirring sound of a hand mixer is introduced and sustained for several seconds. (3) Short, crisp percussive thudding sounds occur as the narrator mentions cutting the fruit, followed by the high-frequency rustling of plastic wrap. (4) A metallic click and a soft hum signify the opening and closing of a refrigerator door. (5) A resonant 'tada' chime sound effect plays as the final dish is revealed. The narrator's voice becomes more expressive and satisfied. (6) The video concludes with a friendly English phrase 'Have a nice day!' spoken with a rising intonation, as the BGM fades out smoothly.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Evidence -> Tutorial -> Result -> Recommendation -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional cooking tutorial for California Grapes. It hooks the audience with a greeting and a visual of a fruit sandwich, provides a step-by-step assembly guide, and concludes with a taste test and health recommendation to encourage consumption.
